name: spotlight
title: Spotlight
description: A surface with a soft highlight that follows the pointer.
a11y: Pointer only and purely visual: no keyboard behaviour depends on it, and the glow is a pseudo-element that is never read aloud.
Content keeps its normal order and focus ring; the glow only appears for hover-capable pointers.

props.name: size
props.description: Radius of the glow in px. Default 240.

usage:
import {Spotlight} from '@monoline/react';

Hover here

A soft light follows the pointer. Keyboard and touch see a plain surface.
